fields.Name: T159 - Compare Runs Side-by-Side
fields.Description: Exercises the PSCompare side-by-side metric grid (deriveCompareColumns/buildCompareMetricRows + best-in-row highlight) — a distinct comparison code path.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Studio' door and select the 'Compare Runs' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Success is the compare view rendering: a session picker dropdown listing sessions that have 2+ scored iterations, and a side-by-side comparison grid where each candidate run is a column, metric rows (holdout score, compute cost) are compared, and the best value in each row is highlighted with a 'BEST' marker plus a plain-language verdict. If nothing is comparable, the 'Nothing to compare yet' empty state is a pass. If a session picker is present, switching sessions should rebuild the comparison.

judgeValidationCriteria: Either a session picker + side-by-side comparison grid with per-row BEST highlighting renders, OR the 'Nothing to compare yet' empty state renders
When comparisons exist, changing the selected session in the picker rebuilds the grid
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
